description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmailsViewSendEmail' which extends 'ViewAjax' and handles displaying email sending status responses in a SuiteCRM email module. It manages the display logic for email sent, error, or bad response states.

classes.name: EmailsViewSendEmail
classes.description: A PHP class responsible for handling AJAX responses related to email sending status within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the class by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs a JSON response indicating the status of an email (sent, error, or bad response) based on the bean's status property.
